leads.name: Ginger Batiks
leads.why: 安邦，做了 10 年；外籍客人为主；自己办圣诞市集；没有网站
leads.verify: IG 简介有没有网站链接；最近有没有发圣诞市集
leads.input:
Ginger Batiks · Instagram @gingerbatiks · Ampang, Kuala Lumpur
Hand block-printed 100% cotton (some silk) homeware and gifts: cushions, pouches, handbags, towels, blankets, kids' toys. Founder Kim Gruia (Canadian, in Malaysia 11 years).
Signals: 2025 was the brand's 10th year. Private home boutique by appointment (booked via Instagram). Runs the Ginger & Spice Markets twice a year (spring and Christmas). Also sold on consignment in other shops.
Budget signal: 10 years in business, expat customer base, consignment stockists, organises her own markets.
Website: none found (gingerbatiks.com / .com.my / .my do not resolve).
Observation (from The Edge / Options feature, Apr–May 2025): entering her 10th year; customers book private boutique visits through Instagram; the Christmas Ginger & Spice Market is her big season.
Angle: let customers browse and order between markets, and send gifts overseas (expat customers shipping home).

leads.name: Ministry of Cakes
leads.why: 八打灵，2015 年开始；有咖啡馆 + 上课工作室；花钱上过 Vulcan Post
leads.verify: IG 简介有没有网站或订蛋糕链接
leads.input:
Ministry of Cakes · Instagram @ministry.of.cakes · Petaling Jaya
Custom buttercream cakes; best seller Gulab Jamun Cheesecake. Started 2015 as 'Caked', rebranded 2017. Run by Lakhshmi Priya.
Signals: physical café with kitchen, a studio for baking classes and private events; online orders started on Facebook and Instagram; plans for bottled iced coffee and ready-to-bake items.
Budget signal: 10 years running, physical café + class studio, paid for a sponsored Vulcan Post feature (May 2024).
Website: none found (ministryofcakes.com / .com.my / .my do not resolve).
Observation (from the Vulcan Post feature, May 2024): the café doubles as a class studio and the Gulab Jamun Cheesecake is the top seller.
Angle: online custom-cake orders (size, flavour, pickup date with lead time) and class booking with payment.

leads.name: Best Borneo
leads.why: 古晋 Voco 酒店楼下的礼品店（2026-07 开）；网站还在「Under Construction」
leads.verify: 网站可能已经有人在做——开场白先问一句
leads.input:
Best Borneo · Instagram @bestborneosarawak · Kuching, ground floor of Voco Kuching (Wisma Elica)
Curated Sarawak gift store: Bowerhaus accessories, woven bags by Penan Women Project, illustrated postcards, kek lapis, brandy fruitcake, Libex coffee, four heirloom rice varieties (Bario, Etem, Bajong, Bireh).
Founders: Datin Shen-Tel Lee (co-founder of jewellery label Bowerhaus) and restaurateur Olivia Ling. Opened end of July 2026, open daily.
Budget signal: retail store inside a hotel building; founders run other established brands.
Website: bestborneo.com.my currently shows only 'Website Under Construction' — someone may already be building it, so ask politely first.
Observation (from The Edge / Options feature, Aug 2026): the heirloom rice is sold individually or as a set of four, and the store mixes crafts with edible Sarawak treats.
Angle: visitors can reorder after leaving Kuching; festive / corporate gift sets. Ask if they already have someone building the site.

leads.name: Habitatku + Loulou
leads.why: 同一对夫妻：Habitatku 蜡烛在中央艺术坊有店，Loulou 卖东南亚手作服饰；两个都没有网站
leads.verify: 找 Habitatku 的 IG；看 Loulou 简介有没有网站
leads.input:
Loulou (Instagram @louloulookbook) and Habitatku (candle brand with a store in Central Market, Kuala Lumpur) · same founders: husband-and-wife Philippe Bertrand and Valerie Khoo
Loulou: handmade skirts and bags in bold Ankara prints from makers in Thailand, Indonesia, Vietnam and Malaysia; only a few pieces arrive each week (e.g. one maker makes four chicken bags a week). Customers are typically mid-30s to 70s.
Budget signal: physical candle store in Central Market (tourist footfall); customer base aged 35–70.
Website: none found for either brand (habitatku / loulou domains do not resolve or are parked).
Observation (from The Edge / Options feature, Jul 2025): Loulou focuses on one designer at a time and each batch of skirts has 20 different patterns.
Angle: one site for both brands; tourists who bought candles at Central Market can reorder; weekly new arrivals for Loulou.

leads.name: Dimpled
leads.why: SS2 意式冰淇淋店（2024 开）；每周新口味；pint RM38–41
leads.verify: IG 简介有没有订购链接
leads.input:
Dimpled · Instagram @dimpledmy · 151, Jalan SS 2/6, SS2, Petaling Jaya
Gelato shop opened 6 June 2024 by Eugenia, who left a 10-year job in Singapore to open it. 2–3 new flavours every week (Honey Milk, Sea Salt Sakura, Espresso Stracciatella).
Pints around RM38–41 (2024 data).
Budget signal: physical shop, premium pricing.
Website: none found.
Observation (from Vulcan Post Aug 2024 and Grazia Feb 2025): weekly rotating flavours; Sea Salt Sakura and Honey Milk get mentioned a lot.
Angle: weekly flavour menu online + pint pre-orders with delivery / pickup time slots; gift cards.

leads.name: Forest Floor
leads.why: 茶味意式冰淇淋，Damansara Utama 有店；用 WhatsApp 接单；pint RM38
leads.verify: 先确认最近还有发文、店还在
leads.input:
Forest Floor · Instagram @forestfloor.my · Damansara Utama, Petaling Jaya (57, Jalan SS 21/1a — confirm still open)
Tea-based gelato (pu-erh, ceremonial matcha). Founded by Shawn Low and Lai Jen Yeh; started in Cheras, moved to Damansara Utama.
Pints RM38; orders taken through a WhatsApp link (2024 data).
Budget signal: physical shop, premium pricing.
Website: none found.
Observation (from Vulcan Post Aug 2024): they take pint orders through a WhatsApp link.
Angle: replace WhatsApp ordering with an online menu that takes payment and delivery slots; tea gift boxes.

leads.name: Artigusto Gelato
leads.contact_source: Malaysian Foodie（2025-03）店家电话
leads.why: Taman Paramount 意式冰淇淋（2024 年底开）；以前的网站已经过期
leads.verify: 看 IG 简介是不是还放着过期的网站链接
leads.input:
Artigusto Gelato · Instagram @artigustogelato · 37, Jalan 20/16, Taman Paramount, Petaling Jaya
Artisanal gelato (Salted Pistachio, Bentong Ginger Chocolate, non-alcoholic Tiramisu), affogato and waffles. Opened late 2024; closed Mondays.
Budget signal: physical shop.
Website: artigustogelato.com currently shows 'Squarespace – Website Expired' (they had a site; it lapsed).
Observation (from Malaysian Foodie Mar 2025): Bentong Ginger Chocolate uses a local ingredient; reviewers single out the Salted Pistachio.
Angle: kindly mention their website link shows 'expired'; our monthly Care includes hosting, SSL and uptime monitoring, so the site doesn't quietly go offline. Do not criticise their old site.

leads.name: Shiramics
leads.why: 手作陶瓷马克杯 RM70 起；以前的网站域名已失效（资料是 2022 年，要确认还在做）
leads.verify: 最近 30 天没发文就跳过
leads.input:
Shiramics · Instagram @shiramicss
Handmade ceramic mugs (handbuilding and wheel throwing) by Shafina Hanafi from Kedah; started March 2021. Mugs from RM70. Had launched 10 collections and aimed for one release a month; production runs of 30 pieces (2022 data).
Budget signal: premium pricing.
Website: shiramics.com no longer resolves (lapsed).
Observation (from The Edge / Options feature, 2022): each run is 30 pieces and takes four to six weeks.
Angle: monthly collection drops with pre-orders on her own site.

leads.name: Over Time Leathercraft
leads.why: 一人工作室的定制皮件；The Edge 2026 报道；老板预算可能不多
leads.verify: IG 简介有没有网站链接
leads.input:
Over Time Leathercraft · Instagram @over_time_leathercraft
Custom leather goods (wallets, cardholders): clients choose design, shape, size, leather and colour, with optional embossed names or initials in metallic lettering. Founder Tan Boon Leong, home studio; full-time since 2024.
Budget signal: handmade custom pricing above big fashion houses (one-person studio, so own budget may be small).
Website: none found.
Observation (from The Edge / Options feature, Apr 2026): the brand is about leather that gets better with wear and tear.
Angle: let customers pick custom options and pay a deposit on the site instead of back-and-forth DMs.

leads.name: Blue Dahlia
leads.contact_source: Buro 247 Nyonya 糕点清单（2025-03 更新）写明 WhatsApp；Malay Mail 2025-04 也列同一号码
leads.why: PJ Section 17 的马六甲娘惹糕店，每天 18–20 种糕点和黄梨挞；Malay Mail、FMT 都报道过，只靠 IG 和 WhatsApp 接单。
leads.verify: 看 IG 有没有接节日 / 派对大订单；黄梨挞一罐卖多少钱。
leads.input:
What they sell / Location: Melaka Peranakan kuih café, 601 Jalan 17/12, Section 17, Petaling Jaya. 18–20 kuih made fresh daily (bingka ubi, talam, ketayap, pulut panggang), pineapple tarts, butter cakes, Nyonya laksa, cendol.
Signals: Malay Mail review (Apr 2025); FMT feature (Feb 2026) on the Peranakan duo Yugin Lee and Nina Yeoh; Buro 247 kuih list (updated Mar 2025); LifestyleAsia Raya kuih list (Feb 2026).
Budget signal: Physical café plus repeated media coverage (no price list published).
Website check: (a) check-domains.sh bluedahlia → PARKED (not theirs); bluedahliamy, bluedahliapj → NONE. (b) Searched 'Blue Dahlia Petaling Jaya kuih order online website': no own site or web shop; Buro lists WhatsApp and Instagram only. (c) No other brand found.
Contacts: WhatsApp 011-2980 3362 (Buro 247, Malay Mail).
Observation: FMT (Feb 2026) 'At Blue Dahlia, serving tasty treats is a piece of kuih': 18 to 20 varieties made fresh every day.
Angle: Kuih platters / party boxes and festive pineapple tart pre-orders with pick-up slots; corporate tea orders.
Sources: https://www.freemalaysiatoday.com/category/leisure/2026/02/05/at-blue-dahlia-serving-tasty-treats-is-a-piece-of-kuih ; https://www.malaymail.com/news/eat-drink/2025/04/05/for-outstanding-melaka-peranakan-kuih-cakes-and-desserts-head-over-to-blue-dahlia-in-section-17-pj/171953 ; https://www.buro247.my/lifestyle/food-drink/10-best-places-to-order-your-favourite-malay-and-nyonya-kuih-in-the-klang-valley.html

leads.name: Baba Beng
leads.contact_source: Buro 247 Nyonya 糕点清单（2025-03 更新）写明 WhatsApp
leads.why: PJ Section 4 的娘惹糕点和娘惹咖椰，Buro 247 2025 年推荐；现在靠 WhatsApp、Facebook 接单。

leads.input:
What they sell / Location: Nyonya kuih and Nyonya kaya, 14 Lorong Assunta A, Section 4, Petaling Jaya. Kuih kochi, pulut tekan, kuih lapis, ketayap; kaya jars.
Signals: Buro 247 kuih list (updated Mar 2025); Malay Mail delivery feature (May 2020); TheSmartLocal Nyonya kuih list.
Budget signal: Physical shop plus media coverage; kaya also sold on Shopee/Lazada (Malay Mail 2020).
Website check: (a) check-domains.sh mybababeng, bababeng → NONE. (b) Searched 'Baba Beng Petaling Jaya Nyonya kaya order online': orders via WhatsApp / Facebook; marketplaces only, no own web shop. (c) No other brand found.
Contacts: WhatsApp 012-288 7449 (Buro 247, Mar 2025).
Observation: Buro 247 lists Nyonya kaya, kuih kochi, pulut tekan, kuih lapis, ordered via Facebook / WhatsApp.
Angle: Own shop for kaya jars (ship nationwide) plus kuih set pre-orders; festive gift boxes.
Sources: https://www.buro247.my/lifestyle/food-drink/10-best-places-to-order-your-favourite-malay-and-nyonya-kuih-in-the-klang-valley.html ; https://www.malaymail.com/news/eat-drink/2020/05/04/mco-food-delivery-savour-baba-bengs-nyonya-kuih-for-that-perfect-teatime-tr/1862812

leads.name: Secawan Tepung
leads.contact_source: Buro 247 糕点清单（2025-03 更新）写明 WhatsApp
leads.why: 22 种 kuih talam 加外烩，100 粒 RM85–90；SAYS 2024、Buro 2025 都推荐，只靠 IG 和 WhatsApp 接单。
leads.verify: 看 IG 最近还有在接单；开场白可以用马来文或英文（看他们 IG 用什么语言）。
leads.input:
What they sell / Location: Kuih maker with pick-up in South Bangsar, KL; 22 types of kuih talam, kuih lapis, angku, bingka ubi; butter cakes, cheesecakes, brownies, Raya cookies; catering.
Signals: SAYS kuih list (Mar 2024); Buro 247 kuih list (updated Mar 2025).
Budget signal: RM85–90 for 100 pieces of kuih (SAYS 2024); catering service.
Website check: (a) check-domains.sh secawantepung → NONE. (b) Searched 'Secawan Tepung kuih order website': only Instagram / WhatsApp; delivery via Grab or Lalamove arranged by them. (c) No other brand found.

Observation: SAYS (Mar 2024) 'boasts a long list of delicious treats, including 22 different types of kuih talam', plus catering.
Angle: Order form for 100-piece trays / event catering with date and quantity; Raya cookie pre-orders.
Sources: https://says.com/my/makan/where-to-buy-kuih-muih ; https://www.buro247.my/lifestyle/food-drink/10-best-places-to-order-your-favourite-malay-and-nyonya-kuih-in-the-klang-valley.html

leads.name: Hideaway Café
leads.contact_source: Malaysia Food and Travel 报道（2025-08，经 Newswav 转载）写的联络电话
leads.why: PJ Happy Mansion 开了约 7 年的娘惹 auntie 牛油蛋糕咖啡馆，2025 年 8 月有报道，没有网站。
leads.verify: 这个号码是报道里的电话，发 WhatsApp 前先看能不能用；看 IG 有没有接整个蛋糕预订。
leads.input:
What they sell / Location: Family-run café, AG7 Block A, Happy Mansion, Section 17, Petaling Jaya. Owner Doreen Thean (Nyonya, former flight attendant) bakes butter cakes daily: lemon drizzle, pandan gula Melaka, banana pecan raisin loaf.
Signals: About seven years open; Malaysia Food and Travel feature (Aug 2025, via Newswav); Tatler Happy Mansion guide; Eat Drink KL.
Budget signal: Physical café plus coverage (no whole-cake prices published).
Website check: (a) check-domains.sh hideaway17, hideawaycafe, hideawaypj → NONE. (b) Searched 'Hideaway Cafe Section 17' order / website: no web shop found. (c) No other brand.
Contacts: 013-757 1237 (Malaysia Food and Travel, Aug 2025).
Observation: Aug 2025 article: 'butter cakes made with Nyonya motherly love', about ten cakes on any given day, baked by Doreen herself.
Angle: Whole butter cake / loaf pre-orders and gift boxes (festive, corporate); simple menu + pick-up site.
Sources: https://newswav.com/article/if-you-love-butter-cakes-made-with-nyonya-motherly-love-happy-mansion-s-hid-A2508_dQGCes ; https://www.tatlerasia.com/dining/food/where-what-to-eat-happy-mansion-in-section-17-pj

leads.name: Contour
leads.contact_source: TheSmartLocal 新年糕点清单（2026-02）写的电话
leads.why: PJ Old Town 的烘豆店 + 烘焙咖啡馆，老板是 Malaysia Barista Champion，2025 年扩店一倍；咖啡豆只在 Shopee 卖，没有自己的网站。
leads.verify: 这个号码在 TheSmartLocal 写成电话，发 WhatsApp 前先确认；看 Shopee 店还有没有在用。
leads.input:
What they sell / Location: Coffee roastery and bakery-café, 55 Jalan 1/12, PJ Old Town, Petaling Jaya. Founder Jason Loo (multi-time Malaysia Barista Champion). Croissants, danishes, seasonal pastries; roasted beans.
Signals: Malay Mail launch feature (Oct 2023); TheSmartLocal on their expansion next door (2025); TheSmartLocal CNY pastry list (Feb 2026); Time Out.
Budget signal: Physical café that doubled its space (TheSmartLocal) plus coverage; sells own roasted beans.
Website check: (a) check-domains.sh contourpj, contourcoffee, contourroastery, contourcoffeepj → NONE; contour.com / contour.com.my are other companies. (b) Searched 'Contour coffee roastery PJ beans online shop': Time Out says beans are sold in-store or on Shopee; no own site. (c) No other brand found.
Contacts: 011-1673 5503 (TheSmartLocal, Feb 2026).
Observation: TheSmartLocal (Feb 2026): Walnut Black Sesame Danish for CNY, orders by phone.
Angle: Own bean shop with subscriptions (higher margin than Shopee), pastry box pre-orders, wholesale beans for offices/cafés.
Sources: https://thesmartlocal.my/chinese-new-year-pastries/ ; https://www.malaymail.com/news/eat-drink/2023/10/12/three-time-malaysia-barista-champion-jason-loo-launches-contour-his-first-coffee-roastery-and-bakery-in-pj-old-town/95755 ; https://thesmartlocal.my/contour-pj/ ; https://www.timeout.com/kuala-lumpur/restaurants/contour

leads.name: Le Petit Four Pâtisserie
leads.contact_source: TheSmartLocal 槟城烘焙店清单（2023-09 更新）和圣诞蛋糕清单写的订购电话
leads.why: 槟城 Lebuh Pantai 的法式甜点店（2018 年开，Le Cordon Bleu 出身的老板），Vulcan Post 2024 报道；以前的网站已经过期。
leads.verify: 看 IG 简介是不是还放着过期的网站；问节日蛋糕 / 整个蛋糕是不是只能打电话订。
leads.input:
What they sell / Location: French patisserie-café, 310 Lebuh Pantai, George Town, Penang. Chef-owner Ooi Hooi Shing (ex-Intel engineer, Le Cordon Bleu Paris, staged at Shangri-La Paris), co-founder Elveen Tai. Croissants, tarts, entremets, festive cakes.
Signals: Opened 2018; Vulcan Post profile (2024) calls it one of Penang's most popular café-bakeries; TheSmartLocal Penang bakeries; So Good magazine feature on the chef.
Budget signal: Physical shop plus coverage; tarts RM16–22 each, Christmas cakes by order.
Website check: (a) check-domains.sh lepetitfourpatisserie → lepetitfourpatisserie.com EXPIRED (title only, no content); lepetitfour.com shows a Wix 'ConnectYourDomain Error'. (b) Searched 'Le Petit Four Patisserie Penang order online website': ordering by phone only. (c) No other brand.
Contacts: 016-409 3918 (TheSmartLocal; Christmas roundup).
Observation: Vulcan Post (2024): 'a stalwart in the Penang patisserie scene for six years'; chef says no big expansion plans, focus on quality.
Angle: Pre-order site for whole cakes and festive bakes (pick-up date, deposit); the old domain is expired so customers who search hit a dead page.
Sources: https://vulcanpost.com/876184/le-petit-four-patisserie-french-pastry-desserts-penang-malaysia ; https://thesmartlocal.my/bakeries-in-penang/ ; https://gempak.com/rojakdaily/lifestyle/sugar-rush-9-places-get-your-christmas-cake-and-sweet-treats-penang-68939

leads.name: Ome by Spacebar Coffee
leads.contact_source: Newswav 转载的报道（2025-04）写的联络电话；2020 年 TheSmartLocal 写 019-309 1450
leads.why: 槟城巷子里的咖啡馆，2025 年入选 World's 100 Best Coffee Shops 第 56 名；店里卖咖啡豆（RM30/150g），没有网上商店。
leads.verify: 两个号码不一样（019-690 8259 / 019-309 1450），发之前看 IG 简介哪个是现在用的。
leads.input:
What they sell / Location: Specialty coffee bar, 1 Lorong Toh Aka, George Town, Penang. Founders Joachim Leong and Shean Tan (ex-baristas; started as a KL pop-up). Sells beans (house blend RM30/150g, single origins RM35/100g in 2020), cakes, chocolate bars.
Signals: No. 56 on the inaugural World's 100 Best Coffee Shops 2025 (Vulcan Post, Time Out Asia, Feb–Apr 2025); Malay Mail since 2015/2017.
Budget signal: Physical café plus international recognition; retail beans.
Website check: (a) check-domains.sh omebyspacebar → NONE; spacebarcoffee.com is a Hostinger parked page. (b) Searched 'Ome Spacebar coffee Penang beans order online website': beans sold in the café only, no web shop. (c) No other brand found.
Contacts: 019-690 8259 (newer article, 2025) / 019-309 1450 (TheSmartLocal 2020).
Observation: Vulcan Post (2025): one of three Malaysian cafés on the World's 100 Best Coffee Shops list.
Angle: Bean shop + subscription for fans outside Penang (the ranking brings visitors who want to reorder at home); gift sets.
Sources: https://vulcanpost.com/881899/malaysian-cafe-the-worlds-100-best-coffee-shops-2025 ; https://newswav.com/article/this-penang-cafe-s-hidden-in-an-alley-but-is-still-listed-among-the-world-s-A2504_ex2oRT ; https://thesmartlocal.my/penang-cafes/amp/

leads.name: Le Dux Patisserie
leads.contact_source: TheSmartLocal 槟城烘焙店清单（2023-09 更新）写的电话
leads.why: 槟城 Lebuh Pantai 的法式甜点店（提拉米苏 RM28、塔 RM19–22）；B 级：只找到 2023 年的推荐。

leads.name: Roost KL
leads.why: 孟沙 Telawi 开了 10 年左右的独立西餐厅，圣诞烤羊肩 / 烤全鸭外卖套餐 RM359–398，现在只能打电话订，roostkl.com 已经打不开。
leads.verify: 先看 IG 今年有没有圣诞外卖套餐的帖子，以及简介里是不是还放着 roostkl.com 这个打不开的链接。
leads.input:
What they sell / Location: Independent modern European restaurant (farm-to-fork), 69-1 Jalan Telawi 3, Bangsar Baru, KL. Festive takeaway roasts every Christmas.
Signals: Running since at least 2014 (Eat Drink KL covered Roost in Nov 2014). Listed by Tatler Dining. In SAYS' Christmas 2025 list (pre-order Angus tomahawk or beef short rib).
Budget signal: Vulcan Post Dec 2023 Christmas takeaway: roasted boneless lamb shoulder (3–5 pax) RM398+, roasted stuffed whole duck (3–5 pax) RM359+, delivery anywhere in Peninsular Malaysia via Grab Express.
Website check: (a) check-domains.sh roostkl → roostkl.com returns a Wix 'ConnectYourDomain Error' page (domain points to Wix but no live site); roost.my is for sale (not theirs); roostbangsar NONE. (b) Searched 'Roost KL order online' / 'website': only phone ordering (+603-2201 1710), no web shop, no Beepit/Oddle/StoreHub found. (c) No other brand by the owners found in coverage.
Observation: SAYS (Christmas 2025 roundup) lists Roost for pre-order Angus tomahawk / beef short rib; Vulcan Post (Dec 2023) lists the lamb shoulder and whole duck sets, ordered by phone with 3 days' notice.
Angle: Festive roast pre-order page (choose set, delivery date, pay deposit) instead of phone calls; year-round 'roast at home' sets and gift vouchers. A friendly note that roostkl.com currently shows an error page.
Sources: https://says.com/my/eats/restaurants-in-klang-valley-to-celebrate-christmas-2025 ; https://vulcanpost.com/847559/restaurants-klang-valley-christmas-takeaway-set-2023 ; https://www.eatdrinkkl.com/posts/snapshot/roost-jaslyn-cakes-telawi-bangsar ; https://www.pressreader.com/malaysia/tatler-dining-malaysia/20200101/284618899379002

What they sell / Location: Independent restaurant, 25 Jalan SS 15/5A, Subang Jaya. Modern Malaysian dishes with a twist (lamb ragout & mango chutney pizza, coconut lamb skewers, spicy lamb linguine). Festive lamb roasts for takeaway.
Signals: Reviewed by The Star (Feb 2019) and Eat Drink KL (2018); listed in Tatler Asia's Subang Jaya guide; in TheSmartLocal's Christmas takeaway list (13 Dec 2025).
Budget signal: Christmas 2025 slow-roasted boneless New Zealand leg of lamb set RM199/kg with sides (up to 4 pax).
Website check: (a) check-domains.sh ratasubang / ratass15 → NONE; rata.com (US company), rata.com.my ('Index of /', not theirs), ratarestaurant.com (Queenstown, NZ) are other businesses. (b) Searched 'RATA restaurant Subang' order online / website: no own site or web shop found; TheSmartLocal says orders are by call/message (012-424 1194). (c) No other brand by the owners found.
Observation: TheSmartLocal (Dec 2025): lamb leg set RM199/kg, orders from 24 Nov by phone. The Star (2019) called it 'where Malaysian food gets a modern, innovative twist'.
Angle: Festive lamb pre-order page with deposit; 'RATA at home' frozen lamb ragout / marinated skewers; party trays for Subang families.
Sources: https://thesmartlocal.my/christmas-takeaways/ ; https://www.thestar.com.my/lifestyle/food/2019/02/19/rata-subang-restaurant-review ; https://www.tatlerasia.com/dining/food/where-to-eat-subang-jaya ; https://www.eatdrinkkl.com/posts/spotlight/rata-ss15-subang

Budget signal: 'Pearl of Orient' 6-inch chiffon cake RM168 (pre-order only); Nian Gao Prosperity Waffle RM33 (TheSmartLocal, Feb 2026).

Sources: https://thesmartlocal.my/chinese-new-year-pastries/ ; https://www.malaymail.com/news/eat-drink/2025/08/05/with-a-new-heritage-cafe-in-petaling-street-heres-how-the-duo-behind-fluffed-and-flurr-built-their-sweet-dreams-one-waffle-at-a-time/186453 ; https://www.timeout.com/kuala-lumpur/restaurants/fluffed-cafe-dessert-bar ; https://www.bangsarbabe.com/2016/03/fluffed-cafe-dessert-bar-taman-paramount.html

Budget signal: Christmas 2025 menu: smoked spring chicken RM56, Swedish meatballs RM45, miso capellini with scallops RM45, beef pot pie RM40 (each 1–2 pax) → about RM40+ per person.
Website check: (a) check-domains.sh najnbelle / najandbelle / najnbellemy → all NONE (a 2018 review mentioned a website; it no longer resolves). (b) Searched 'Naj & Belle Bangsar order online' / 'website': no web shop found; SAYS only points to Instagram @najnbelle. (c) No other brand by the owners found.
Observation: SAYS (Nov 2025) 'Naj & Belle Bangsar's Christmas menu brings homely festive flavours in a small, easygoing menu', available from 20 Nov for dine-in and takeaway.
Angle: Festive takeaway pre-orders (pick date, pay online), party trays, a simple menu + location site replacing the dead old domain.
Sources: https://says.com/my/lifestyle/eats/naj-and-belle-christmas-2025 ; https://says.com/my/eats/restaurants-in-klang-valley-to-celebrate-christmas-2025 ; https://www.malaysianfoodie.com/2025/09/naj-belle-where-local-traditions-meet-modern-indulgence.html ; https://discoverkl.com/2018/08/09/naj-belle-ss15-subang-jaya-food-review

leads.batch: 2026-11-14 Kuchai Lama（俊宇：找新目标，可以是中国餐厅；再找不一样的咖啡店）
leads.input:
What they sell / Location: Sourdough bakery in a bungalow at A6, Jalan Rukun 7, Taman Gembira (Happy Garden), off Jalan Kuchai Lama, KL 58200. Sourdough breads (24-hour process), blueberry raisin cream cheese rye, cream cheese cheddar boule, buns and bagels, grilled cheese sandwiches, cakes and pastries; they have made occasion cakes including a wedding cake. Open Wed-Sun 9am-6pm. It is a pick-up shop, not a cafe.
Signals: Started online in 2015 (founder Gillian Beh, self-taught; learned sourdough from an artisan in Thailand); grew from baking whole cakes in a small Serdang apartment to the Happy Garden bungalow. FMT Lifestyle feature (11 Jul 2023, 'House called The Baking Trip sells glorious breads and cakes'); Eat Drink KL featured post calling it Happy Garden's home for the neighbourhood's widest variety of sourdough specialities and cakes; Chiefeater review (whisky raisin bun, RM20-50 per pax).
Budget signal: A whole bungalow as the bakery, media coverage, whole cakes and occasion cakes; in business since 2015.
Website check: (a) check-domains.sh thebakingtrip, bakingtrip, thebakingtripkl -> NONE. (b) No website, Beep, StoreHub or take.app page found; FMT 2023 says the team accepts orders on Instagram, Eat Drink KL lists 'Order on IG'. (c) No other brand found.
Contacts: IG @_thebakingtrip_ (FMT 2023); phone 019-576 1419 (FMT 2023 and Eat Drink KL).
Observation: FMT (Jul 2023): the sourdough takes 24 hours to make; her partner is now the main baker and her sister makes the cakes and pastries.
Angle: Orders come in by Instagram DM today. A pre-order page with pick-up days and time slots (bread sells out), whole-cake orders with a lead time, and Christmas / Chinese New Year bakes with a cut-off date (RM399 festive shop or RM800 website).
Sources: https://www.freemalaysiatoday.com/category/leisure/2023/07/11/house-called-the-baking-trip-sells-glorious-breads-and-cakes ; https://www.eatdrinkkl.com/posts/featured/the-baking-trip-happy-garden-s-wholesome-home-for-the-neighbourhood-s-widest-variety-of-sourdough-specialities-cakes ; https://chiefeater.com/single-location/kuchai-lama

faq: How do I order?
Add the kuih to your cart and choose a pick-up or delivery date at checkout. You can also order on WhatsApp (011-1165 5688) or on Instagram (@secawantepung).
Where is pick-up?
South Bangsar, Kuala Lumpur. We'll WhatsApp you the exact pick-up point and time after you order.
Do you deliver?
Yes, by Grab or Lalamove. The fee depends on the distance and is confirmed with you before delivery.
How is the kuih sold?
Per 100 pieces. Choose from 22 types of kuih talam, kuih lapis, angku, bingka ubi and more, sweet and savoury. WhatsApp us for the full list.
Can you cater for a party or open house?
Yes. Send us the date and the number of guests on WhatsApp and we'll send you a quote.
Do you have Raya cookies?
Yes, for the Raya season. Ask us what's available this year.
